content: Hello, this is Tech Solutions. How can I assist you today?

Thank you. I've tried restarting my computer and the VPN app, but nothing works.
Don't worry, that's a good start. I have the tools to check your account and network status directly. You can trust me to handle this efficiently.

Just a moment while I verify your connection logs. I'll guide you step-by-step through any settings adjustments if needed.
